messages:
sana: Quick proposal — add per-route redaction 'levels' (none | hash | redact) + a secondary 'audit-mode' that stores only hashed identifiers for 30d. want buy-in before i write the RFC.

mike: can you sketch when we'd pick hash vs redact? seems like we'd want different behavior for embeddings vs generation.

sana: yea — idea is: short, structured responses (embeddings, rerank) => hash; free-text generation => redact by default. but ops/routes could override.

jonah: how do we surface that in the console? per-route toggle? tag + rollout?

sana: per-route checkbox + a global default. rollout via existing canary flags (no extra infra). console shows the effective level and retention window.

nicole: concern: hashed ids are still PII if predictable. we should HMAC with tenant key and rotate.

sana: agreed — plan is HMAC(tenant_kms_key, value) + versioned salt. rotation means we re-hash new traffic; old hashes expire with retention.

mike: ops question: do we need to store redacted payloads for debugging incidents? sometimes redact loses signal for rootcause.

sana: propose an 'oncall-inspect' flow: ephemeral unredact for 1h, logged in audit, requires RBAC + approval. no decrypted PII ever stored on disk.

telemetry-bot: Note: existing pipeline expects full request/response JSON for metrics extraction. Changing schema may break parsers. Suggest a compatibility shim layer.

jonah: what about quotas & billing? if we redact early, we still need token counts. but downstream parsers might rely on fields to route to specialized processors.

sana: keep token/size metadata outside redaction path. processors get a minimal header {route, model, token_count, redaction_level} + sanitized body.

mike: can you paste a sample of the config UI + wire format?

sana: sure — quick example: 
```json
{"route": "/v1/generate", "default_redaction": "redact", "overrides": [{"tenant": "acme", "level": "hash"}], "audit_retention_days": 30}
```

jonah: wire format for runtime: 
```json
{"meta": {"route": "/v1/generate", "redaction": "hash", "token_count": 342}, "payload": {"prompt": "[REDACTED]", "response": "[REDACTED]"}}
```

nicole: need to add fields for hash_version and hmac_key_id in meta so we can decode/rotate safely.

sana: good call.

mike: rollout plan? I suggest farm a small subset of low-risk routes + opt-in tenants, run for 2 weeks, monitor error rate + mean debug time.

sana: proposed rollout: 1) shim & console UI; 2) opt-in canary (5% routes); 3) tenant opt-in; 4) auto-enforce defaults. metrics: missing-fields, debug-sessions started, oncall-unredact-requests.

jonah: one more: E2E tests — add synthetic requests with edge-case PII (phone, ssn, long docs) to ensure scrubbers don't choke parsers.

sana: will add test vectors. i'll draft the RFC by Tue and tag security & legal. anyone object to that timeline?

mike: fine with timeline.

nicole: LGTM, please include KMS rotation notes.

telemetry-bot: Added reminder: file a cross-team RFC in #rfc-tracker and include sample logs.

sana: thanks — i'll drop the RFC link when ready. :thumbsup:
